cohort: 75 pregnancies with foetal premature atrial contractions (PACs), identified from ultrasound exams at a high volume referral centre
finding: Isolated foetal premature atrial contractions (PACs) are a benign finding and are not associated with abnormal pregnancy outcomes, regardless of the presence or absence of foetal breathing.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery did not differ between foetuses with PACs and associated breathing and those with PACs and no associated breathing.
